# v1.0.0 — Stable 1.0

First 1.0 release, compared with 0.10.0.

- **Charge level with its age:** a vehicle charge target chosen in the app is judged only on a level the car reported within the last 15 minutes. A report of the car's charge limit, or a poll, no longer makes an old level look current.
- **No stale drafts on the Charging page:** a target changed elsewhere stays marked as changed when you save another one, instead of being saved over the newer value.
- **German network prices only in euros:** the §14a network price modules are offered, imported, renewed and applied only while Home Assistant is set to Germany and euros.

**Updating from 0.10.0:** update the app and the integration to **1.0.0** together (service API 4).

Hardware tests on the maintainer's wallbox look good so far; please report what you see on other wallboxes.

Every contribution is voluntary and very welcome; support and new features stay open to everyone either way.
